change.item: Package name matches the listing in the Joomla Extensions Directory again.
Code cleanup for the JED Checker (admin menu name, byte order mark).

addition.item: New backend component to manage locations: create, edit, publish, search and filter.
CSV/XLSX import with preview, automatic column detection, matching by external ID and safety limit for removals.
Geocoding with OpenStreetMap Nominatim in several stages (exact to approximate), at the click of a button or as a scheduled task.
Scheduled tasks for importing a file from the server and for geocoding.
Module settings for colours, map height, tile server, directions provider and country filter.

change.item: Module rebuilt for Joomla 5 and 6 with its own database table, language files and assets.
